history.content: idk why im even typing this. my sister keeps texting me about the family thing this weekend and i just feel nothing about it
That sounds really flat and far away. Does it feel more numb, blank, or just hard to name?
blank i guess. like everyone else gets excited or stressed or whatever and im just. there. watching it happen. not really sure these apps do anything but my therapist said try journaling so
Blank makes sense here — like you’re there, but a bit on the outside of it. Does it feel more like nothing is getting through, or like you’re watching it happen from a distance?

from a distance. yeah. its the dinner this weekend. its my dads thing, his 60th, everyones flying in. and i just keep thinking i should care more and i dont and that feels worse than anything honestly
That sounds like distance plus a sharp kind of self-judgment about not caring enough. Do you want to stay with that part, or leave it here for now?

no i can stay. i think. its weird typing to a thing but ok. the not caring isnt new with him. its been like this for years. ever since the stuff with my mom he just kind of checked out and so did i and now we do this fake warm thing at holidays and i smile and i feel completely empty doing it
That sounds really empty and a bit split between the smile and what you actually feel. Is the stronger part the emptiness, or the fake-warm feeling?

the emptiness. the fake warm is just the costume. underneath theres just. nothing. and i used to feel SO much about him when i was a kid, like i adored him, and idk where that went. it just turned off at some point and i didnt even notice it leaving
That sounds like a turn-off that happened so quietly you only noticed the empty space after. Would you like to stay with that, or leave it here for now?

stay i guess. its the only place ive said any of this out loud. sort of. my sister thinks im cold. she does all the emotional labor with him and i just show up and leave. and maybe she's right maybe i am cold. but it doesnt feel like cold from in here it feels like a power outage
That sounds more like a power outage than cold — not a lack of care, but a cut in what reaches you. Is it more blank, shut down, or just hard to get at?

shut down probably. like it tripped a breaker years ago to protect something and just never flipped back. huh. i havent thought about it like that. that its protecting me from something. ok the power outage thing actually got me a little. didnt expect that from an app ngl

maybe not tonight. i think thats a therapist thing not a 11pm phone thing. but ill sit with the breaker idea. its more than i usually get out of these. i still dont know how im gonna get through saturday but i feel a tiny bit less broken about not feeling anything. thats something
